def policy(obs, P):
    x = obs[0]
    v = obs[1]
    ang = obs[2]
    ang_v = obs[3]
    score = P['w_ang']*ang + P['w_angv']*ang_v + P['w_x']*x + P['w_v']*v + P['b']
    return 1 if score > P['thr'] else 0
